Benchmarks How Prism compares, on every plan The same model at every tier. On Artificial Analysis's speech-to-speech leaderboard, Prism starts speaking in 0.57 seconds and scores 56.6 on τ-Voice, ahead of every realtime model from OpenAI and Google that isn't reasoning first. Talk to a voice specialist about your latency budget, languages, and deployment. We'll help you pick in one call. Schedule a call Try for free Questions, answered How is Rime priced? Every account starts with $50 of usage free every month, across every Rime model, with no card required. Past that, the Flex plan is pay as you go by the minute of audio, with no minimum: Mist v3 is $0.03 per minute, Coda v2 is $0.05 per minute, Prism is $0.08 per minute, and Rime STT is free until November 19, then $0.002 per minute. Text to speech is metered by characters generated, about 1,000 characters per minute. The Scale plan takes 20% off every rate for $100 a month, and Enterprise plans move to volume pricing on an annual commitment. Can I get volume discounts for Rime? Yes. The Enterprise plan is built around volume pricing for organizations running at scale, with SLAs and dedicated support included. Talk to us and we'll shape a plan around your usage. Is speech to text really free? Yes. Rime STT is free on every plan through November 19, 2026. From November 20 it is $0.002 per minute on Flex and $0.0016 on Scale, metered by audio duration. Concurrency limits still apply during the free period. What happens when I use up the free $50? Your free usage renews each month and doesn't roll over. To keep going before then, move to Flex: add a card and you're billed pay as you go at the rates above, with no monthly fee and nothing to cancel. If your usage is steady, Scale gives you $100 of credit a month at 20% off every rate, with unused credit rolling over up to $200. Does Rime have an open API? Yes. Text to speech streams over HTTP and WebSockets, speech to text over WebSocket and gRPC, and Prism over WebSockets. All of them can self-host on your own hardware when compliance demands it. Most teams are up and running the same afternoon.
